inspiration.observed_pattern: A MySQL SELECT DISTINCT projection removes duplicate values and orders the resulting set by the projected column.
inspiration.mysql_mariadb_translation: Reauthored as a service-label directory. Fixed service rows contain repeated labels and one NULL label; SELECT DISTINCT must emit each present label once and preserve the single NULL value under deterministic ordering. The source table, columns, rows, and foreign-data-wrapper context are not copied.

fixture_notes: Five service rows reduce to three non-NULL labels plus one NULL result. Repeated labels must collapse while the NULL label remains one distinct value.
determinism_notes: Service IDs and labels are fixed; the distinct result is ordered by the projected label with MariaDB's NULL-first ordering. No clocks, randomness, sleeps, or concurrent schedules are used.
setup: CREATE TABLE service_label_rows (service_id INT PRIMARY KEY, service_label VARCHAR(24) NULL)
INSERT INTO service_label_rows VALUES (101, 'edge'), (102, 'core'), (103, 'edge'), (104, NULL), (105, 'archive'), (106, NULL)

steps.sql: SELECT DISTINCT service_label FROM service_label_rows ORDER BY service_label
